 The Amazon Black Friday Sale is now on at Amazon.sg, running till the 30 November at 23:59 SGT. For 12 days, shoppers can enjoy hundreds of thousands of deals at up to 40% off on quality, well-loved brands from the U.S., Japan and Germany. Whether you're ticking off your holiday gift list, stocking up on home essentials or treating yourself to the latest tech, here's what you can shop this Black Friday at amazon.sg/blackfriday .
 "Black Friday is one of the most exciting shopping moments of the year for customers in Singapore, and we're thrilled to bring 12 days of incredible savings to help shoppers find everything they need for the holiday season," said Peter Li, Country Manager, Amazon Singapore. "Whether you're looking for quality international brands from the U.S., Japan, or Germany, or searching for the perfect gift across categories like electronics, beauty, and home essentials, Amazon.sg is here to make holiday shopping easy and convenient. With great value and a wide selection, there's never been a better time to shop on Amazon.sg."
 Black Friday Sale Highlights 
For 12 days, Amazon Singapore will roll out hundreds of thousands of Black Friday deals at up to 40% off, running from 19 to 30 November.
 Baby and Toys 
 Up to 30% off on Crayola, Hot Wheels, Melissa & Doug, Hasbro, ThinkFun, Funko and National Geographic Magazines
 Up to 25% off Burt's Bees Baby and Dr. Brown’s
 Up to 20% off on VTech, Pampers & Huggies and Frida Baby
 Electronics 
 Up to 40% off Bowers & Wilkins
 Up to 30% off Braun, Oral B and UGREEN
 Up to 25% off Philips, ASUS
 Up to 20% off Samsung and Garmin
 Home & Kitchen 
 Up to 40% off Bialetti, Hansgrohe, Owala
 Up to 30% off WMF, GROHE, Joseph Joseph, Hario and TEMPUR
 Up to 25% off on Hydro Flask, OXO and KitchenAid
 Up to 20% off STAUB
 Beauty and Personal Care 
 Up to 35% off Bioderma
 Up to 30% off on NIVEA and Aveeno
 Up to 20% off Olaplex and LANEIGE
 Fashion and Apparel 
 Up to 30% off on Dickies, Hanes, Speedo
 Up to 25% off on CamelBak, ARENA, Skechers, BOSS, Chums
 Up to 20% off on KEEN, Timberland, Vans and Salomon
 Terms and conditions apply to all promotions listed above. 
 Visit the Amazon Black Friday Photobooth Pop-Up
 Get into the Black Friday spirit at the Amazon Black Friday Photobooth Pop-Up at Suntec City Tower 5 Linkway, Level 1 (near Coffee Bean and Braun Buffel), open daily from 11am to 9pm from 23 to 29 November. Drop by to see a sneak peek of products on deal, snap your Black Friday moment at the AI-powered photobooth and walk away with vouchers to shop the sale. Simply follow Amazon.sg on Instagram or Facebook , choose an AI theme and snap your photo, get a S$5 voucher for yourself and share the other $5 voucher with a loved one so you can both shop the sale together. Limited redemptions per day; terms apply.
 Prime Membership 
Prime membership in Singapore offers more than great deals. All for just S$4.99/month or S$49.90/year. Start with a free 30-day trial at Amazon.sg/prime.
Prime membership benefits in Singapore include:
 Free delivery on millions of eligible items
 Unlimited streaming of award-winning movies and TV shows on Prime Video
 Discover and claim PC games each month on Amazon Luna
 Exclusive access to members-only deal events throughout the year
 Prime members enjoy up to 10% off on over a million products on Amazon.sg
 *Terms and conditions apply to all promotions listed above.
